summary: The Access page shows what a change gives before you make it, who has a permission, a people-by-groups grid, and can copy one admin's access to another.

new.title: See the impact before you give
new.text: Each give says how many permissions it reaches and how many are Tier 0. A give that reaches Tier 0 or many permissions asks first.

new.title: Who has this
new.text: Click a group or permission to see everyone who has it and how, with a remove per person and a CSV export.

new.title: Matrix, make like and compare
new.text: Matrix shows people and their direct groups as a grid: select a box to give, clear it to remove. Make like copies one admin's access to another; Compare shows two admins. Every change still goes through Pending changes.
